title: 联邦快递预测本财年利润增长 市场期待已久
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I do want to talk a little bit about the guidance and looks relatively strong there and if you just strip the note look at the aggregate numbers and look at the growth rates.
segments.zh: 我想谈谈业绩指引，看起来相当强劲。如果只看整体数字和增长率，确实比前几个季度有所改善。

segments.en: They do look like there are an improvement over what we were what we had seen in the previous quarters.
segments.zh: 它们看起来确实比前几个季度有所改善。

segments.en: So what does a FedEx without FedEx freight look like to you going forward?
segments.zh: 那么，剥离货运业务后的联邦快递未来会是什么样？

segments.en: Well, you know, there's still a lot of work to do with FedEx and they've been doing it for a long time.
segments.zh: 联邦快递还有很多工作要做，而且他们已经做了很长时间。

segments.en: It's been years probably, I think since FedEx has blown us away on the top line.
segments.zh: 可能已经好几年了，我认为联邦快递在营收上还没有让我们惊艳过。

segments.en: The economy hasn't been a tremendous driver of what the company has been doing but they've moved to unlock some value here by moving the freight business into a separately traded stock.
segments.zh: 经济并未成为公司发展的巨大驱动力，但他们通过将货运业务分拆为独立权益资产来释放价值。

segments.en: The company has consistently found ways to unlock value whether it be in cost cutting, buying back stock, getting more efficient in terms of their CAPX which has been going on for years.
segments.zh: 公司一直在寻找释放价值的方法，无论是削减成本、回购权益资产，还是提高资本支出效率，这些都已持续多年。

segments.en: I would say the unique thing at this point in FedEx's history is an investment.
segments.zh: 我认为联邦快递历史上目前独特的一点是**。

segments.en: The expectations were quite high. The stock's been up 80%. Over the last 12 months, so a little bit of a softer guide here is.
segments.zh: 市场预期相当高，股价在过去12个月上涨了80%，所以这次指引略显疲软。

segments.en: Yeah, I was taking it down a bit. Well, with regards to the investment side, I mean, you can't really argue with the sheer performance but I am curious.
segments.zh: 是的，我稍微调低了预期。就**方面而言，你无法否认其出色的表现，但我很好奇。

segments.en: I mean, you mentioned they've obviously done a lot of cost-cucketing, cutting, they have other initiatives out there designed to make this company more efficient.
segments.zh: 你提到他们显然做了很多成本削减，还有其他举措来提高效率。
